gui.structurify.structures.structure.all: Жидкости, воздух и другие "special" блоков will count as solid блоков and will not fail check.
gui.structurify.structures.structure.fla:
The Режим based on how Проверка ровности поверхности checks for height differences.

Автоматически: Max. разница высот is calculated automatically per each структура area and number of pieces.

Вручную: Max. разница высот is specified by the Вход field below.
Максимально допустимая разница высот between highest and lowest terrain positions within checked area. структуры will only Создавать if terrain variation does not exceed this value.
gui.structurify.structures.structure.ove: Whenever to override Проверка биома from global or „%s“ namespace настройки with specific настройки of the „%s“ структура.
gui.structurify.structures.structure.ena: If all биомы within specified расстояние are present in list below.
gui.structurify.structures.structure.bio:
The Режим based on what Проверка биома checks the биомы.

Strict: If any part of the структура intersects a биом not specified in its биом list, the структура will not Создавать.

Blacklist: If any part of the структура intersects a биом specified in blacklisted биомы list below, the структура will not Создавать.
List of current blacklisted биомы/биом tags in which the „%s“ структура can not be создано when the Проверка биома is Включено.
List of current биомы in which the „%s“ структура will be создано.
gui.structurify.structures.structure.jig: Size

size (depth) of jigsaw структуры to Создавать.

 - 20: Biggest структура
 - 1: Smallest структура
Start height type

type of height provider.

 - Constant: Specify a constant height
 - Uniform: Random value in a uniform distribution
 - Biased To Bottom: Random value, biased towards bottom
 - Very Biased To Bottom: Random value
 - Trapezoid: Random value, isosceles trapezoidal distribution
Vertical Anchor type

type of vertical anchor.

 - Absolute: An absolute height as seen on F3 screen
 - Above Bottom: A relative height starting at bottom of world
 - Below Top: A relative height starting at top of world. Higher values move height down
Height
Numeric height used by selected anchor type — either absolute Y level or offset from world bottom/top.
минимум height
Lowest possible height (absolute Y or offset from bottom/top, depending on anchor type).
максимум height
Highest possible height (absolute Y or offset from bottom/top, depending on anchor type).
Bias strength
Controls how strongly heights are biased toward bottom, higher values increase chance of lower heights.
Plateau
Width of flat middle range where heights are evenly distributed, larger values widen this range.
Max. расстояние from структура center (in блоков)
The максимум расстояние from the структура center (in блоков), where can part of the структура (jigsaw piece) be создано.
Max. horizontal расстояние from структура center (in блоков)
The максимум horizontal расстояние from the структура center (in блоков), where can part of the структура (jigsaw piece) be создано.
Max. vertical расстояние from структура center (in блоков)
The максимум vertical расстояние from the структура center (in блоков), where can part of the структура (jigsaw piece) be создано.
Project start to heightmap
структура's starting height to match terrain surface after initial placement.
gui.structurify.structures.structure.is_: When Отключено, the структура will not Создавать.
gui.structurify.structures.structure.ter: type of terrain adaptation used for the структура.
gui.structurify.structures.structure.tem: Weight represent chance of being chosen over others. Bigger weight means higher chance of being chosen.
gui.structurify.structure_sets.warning: Bear in mind that each структура set may have unique placement rules and overrides defined by individual mods and datapacks, which means that changing this value might not always produce intended структура spread.
Configure custom структура spread either via global spacing and separation modifier or per структура specific spacing and separation values.
gui.structurify.structure_sets.enable_gl: Включить global spacing and separation modifier
Spacing and separation of each структура set will be multiplied by this value.
gui.structurify.structure_sets.global_sp:
When different from default value of 1.0, each структура set will be either more concentrated or more spread out.

 < 1.0 - more concentrated 
 = 1.0 - unaffected 
 > 1.0 - more spread out
gui.structurify.structure_sets.override_: Whenever to override global spacing and separation modifier from Глобальные настройки with specific настройки of the „%s“ структура set.
gui.structurify.structure_sets.salt.desc: Salt is a number used as a seed for random generator, which controls how структуры are scattered in world, each структура set should have an unique salt.
gui.structurify.structure_sets.frequency:
Frequency is likelihood of a структура attempting to Создавать when all other conditions are met.

 - 1.0: 100% chance to Создавать
 - 0.0: 0% chance to Создавать
gui.structurify.structure_sets.spacing.d: Spacing is average расстояние in chunks between структуры within same структура set (group of структуры).
gui.structurify.structure_sets.separatio: Separation is the минимум расстояние in chunks between структуры within same структура set (group of структуры). separation value cannot be greater than spacing value.
gui.structurify.structure_sets.structure: When Отключено, the структура set will not Создавать.
Weight represent chance of being chosen over others. Bigger weight means higher chance of being chosen.
